subject.title: Subagent process death emits no telemetry — sessions_spawn failures leave no span/trace

question: What stable diagnostics contract should OpenClaw expose for spawned subagent death or termination events?
rationale: The missing emission point is clear in current source, but schema, span parenting, low-cardinality reasons, and redaction rules are public observability contract choices.

options.title: Add Subagent Terminal Event
options.body: Emit a new trusted diagnostic event from subagent terminal paths and map it to OTel with redacted identifiers and stable reason fields.

options.title: Annotate Spawn Span Only
options.body: Attach failure information to the parent sessions_spawn tool span, accepting weaker coverage for deaths after the spawn tool call returns.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Dispatch Telemetry
options.body: Track this under the broader receiver-entry telemetry design, accepting that downstream death clustering stays blind until that larger contract lands.

recommendation.title: Add Subagent Terminal Event
recommendation.body: Emit a new trusted diagnostic event from subagent terminal paths and map it to OTel with redacted identifiers and stable reason fields.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest feature-history signal for the subagent lifecycle origin points to steipete, with vincentkoc as the recent diagnostics/exporter-adjacent owner.
